title: minecraft-sound-fix
description: Swaps the sounds of different mobs, and adds new ones. You'll never know what you're around, and laugh every time a chicken moos
body:
The sounds in minecraft are too dam predictable!!! This mod fixes that issue by adding in some new sounds for existing mobs, and shuffling about the sounds of others. You'll never know what is supposed to be what.

So if you want a laugh every time a chicken moos, this is the mod for you

Mobs with implemented sounds:
  - Chicken
  - Zombie Piglin

Mod dependancies:
  - Fabric API
